name: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops
summary: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan has finished working out his recipe. He still needs twenty Goblin Rocket Fuel and twenty Deeprock Salt from you, and he wants them fast so the meat you brought him does not spoil.

sections.title: What Dirge Still Needs
sections.body: Dirge Quikcleave sees to the spices himself, and the meat you brought him makes up the remainder of the dish. All he lacks is rocket fuel and deeprock salt, twenty of each. With those in his hands, the chicken will be ready to go back to Narain Soothfancy. Dirge urges you not to dawdle, because he does not want the meat going bad.

aliases: who gives dirge's kickin chimaerok chops
faq.answer: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan asks for them, to finish his recipe.

faq.q: What ingredients does Dirge Quikcleave need?
faq.answer: Dirge wants twenty Goblin Rocket Fuel and twenty Deeprock Salt. The spices are his own job, and the meat you gave him covers the rest.

faq.q: Who is the finished dish intended for?
faq.answer: Dirge says that once you bring him what he asked for, the bird is ready to be carried back to Narain Soothfancy.

faq.q: What comes after delivering these ingredients?
aliases: what do i do after dirge chops
faq.answer: Return to Narain is the next step.
